title: 2021–2022 Arts Frances B. Cashin Fellow College of William and Mary
bio: David Dominique is an artist, composer, and journalist working in multiple genres and formats. Currently, he lives in Richmond, Virginia, and is an assistant professor of music at William & Mary.
